question: Oda-sensei!! Boss Kyoshiro is really cool, isn't he?!! I love him!! I want a figurine of him!! The fact that you made such a character in such a world makes me glad to have been born. Please tell me the Boss's height and favorite food!!
answer: Kyoshiro! You really get it, don't you~? I also feel like I gave it my all in designing him!! I received several questions regarding the Nine Red Scabbards, so you can have everybody's heights and favorite foods. While we're at it, I included Shinobu and Izou as well. Kouzuki Oden :382 cm :All types of oden Denjiro :306 cm :Beef tendon Nekomamushi :522 cm :Lasagna and kamaboko Kin'emon :295 cm :Daikon Kikunojo :287 cm :Shirataki Ashura Doji :544 cm :Kinchaku mochi Kanjuro :347 cm :Cabbage rolls Kawamatsu :271 cm :Eggs Shinobu :180 cm :Hanpen Raizo :311 cm :Gobo-maki Inuarashi :511 cm :Bones and chicken wings Izou :192 cm :Ganmodoki Indeed. It seems like everyone likes ingredients that are commonly put in Oden.
